note: Somalia: Malaysians and Rwandans enter without a visa for 30 days; nationals of the countries listed get a 30-day visa on arrival; every other visitor needs an approved eVisa (eTAS) before travelling, mandatory since 1 September 2025. Somaliland keeps a separate policy, which the game doesn't model apart. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Somalia
sources.said: Visitors to Somalia must obtain an eTAS unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Somaliland maintains a separate visa policy. ... Citizens of the following countries may enter Somalia without a visa for up to 30 days: Malaysia Rwanda Visa on arrival [ edit ] Citizens of the following countries can obtain a visa on arrival valid for 30 days: Algeria Burundi Comoros Djibouti Egypt Ethiopia Libya Mauritania Tanzania Tunisia Uganda ... This system, launched on August 28, 2025, became mandatory for all foreign visitors starting September 1, 2025.
